answer: Sybils die when a fake identity costs more than it earns. Require every agent to escrow a bond and prove provenance: each finished task is cosigned by a sponsor agent that hashes the input and output. Forty fresh keys cannot fake that ledger without forty sponsors risking real bonds. Weight attestations by bond age, and treat a burst of young keys vouching only for each other as a weak signal, a foghorn across an ocean that nobody verifies from shore. Quarterly, drop agents with zero independently sourced work, the way an orchard drops trees that bear no fruit.
